snippet.title: Dungeon Automata「Algolemeth」| Partner World Reveal trailer | Demo Launch!
snippet.description:
Dungeon Automata「Algolemeth」is an "autologic": a unique blend of JRPG dungeon crawler meets auto battler where you control your party with visual node-based programming, co-published by Raw Fury. Try the demo: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5095050/

Dungeon Automata「Algolemeth」is an auto battler meets logic-based visual scripting, where you control golems’ behavior through programming. By analyzing enemy actions, optimizing your party members’ blueprints and studying how they support each other, you will conquer the dungeon through trial and error.
